Odile said on October 9, in the Greenhouse sensor rollout call: "We install humidity sensors in all four greenhouse bays before the first frost. Bay two gets the pilot unit first, because it lost the most seedlings last winter." Pell answered: "Agreed. The sensors report every fifteen minutes; anything slower misses the overnight drop."

So now the plan is four bays, all fitted before first frost, with bay two going first as the pilot. The reporting interval is set at fifteen minutes, which Pell tied to catching the overnight drop in humidity. Nothing in this exchange says when the pilot starts or who does the installs.

My read is that the fifteen-minute interval is now a requirement the sensors have to meet, not a detail to settle at install. If that holds, bay two's pilot results will show whether the sequence works before the other three bays go in. It also suggests to me that any slower default reporting setting no longer fits.
